definition: in a very lovely and pleasing way
description: A mirror selfie in an elegant hotel corridor with a black and white marble floor. The view moves from a gold-framed mirror into the corridor. A young woman in a long emerald green satin gown holds up her phone, turns so the flowing train spreads across the floor, and smiles widely. A white cat walks onto the train. Behind her a young woman in a short black dress kicks up a leg and laughs, a brass luggage trolley stands by the wall, and glass lamps hang from the ceiling.
